environment_notes: Historical Three Kingdoms era treacherous mountain pass
Steep rocky cliffs with snow and ice
style_notes: Harsh, dramatic lighting emphasizing the treacherous journey

semantic_context.visual_goal: Establish the historical war-epic scale and the extreme difficulty of the terrain.
semantic_context.action_focus: The collective struggle of the troops leaning into the wind.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Sweep across the struggling soldiers to establish scale and the treacherous conditions.
video_motion_hints: The camera pans slowly across the struggling soldiers. Violent wind continuously whips the banner and drives thick snow horizontally through the frame.

semantic_context.visual_goal: Demonstrate the general's unwavering resolve and physical strength.
semantic_context.action_focus: General Zhao planting his halberd to stay upright.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Keep the halberd plant central to the frame to show his anchoring strength.
video_motion_hints: General Zhao leans his heavy weight onto the halberd, bracing against a massive gust of wind. His tattered red cape forcefully flaps and snaps in the blizzard.

semantic_context.visual_goal: Capture the raw leadership and desperation in the general's command.
semantic_context.action_focus: Zhao shouting over his shoulder into the howling wind.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Slow push-in on Zhao's face as he turns to shout to his men.
video_motion_hints: A slow push-in zoom on Zhao's face as he yells with urgent intensity. Thick white snow aggressively whips past his face in the foreground.

semantic_context.visual_goal: Show the immediate motivational impact of the general's words.
semantic_context.action_focus: Soldiers marching past with renewed vigor.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Track alongside the passing soldiers, with Zhao in the foreground.
video_motion_hints: The camera tracks alongside the moving soldiers as they trudge forward. They lean heavily against the wind while Zhao stands steadfast like an unmoving pillar.

environment_notes: Night sky illuminated by distant fires of a siege
Steep descent path leading into the valley
style_notes: High contrast night lighting lit by distant siege fires

semantic_context.visual_goal: Reveal the stakes of the battle and the vulnerability of the enemy's rear flank.
semantic_context.action_focus: The glowing, burning city in the dark valley.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Establish the immense scale of the siege below from Zhao's vantage point.
video_motion_hints: Thick smoke drifts slowly upward from the burning city deep in the valley. Subtle, flickering firelight dances across Zhao's armor in the dark foreground.

semantic_context.visual_goal: Transition the energy from observation to imminent, explosive action.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Follow Zhao as he wheels his horse around to address the troops.
video_motion_hints: The camera pans to follow Zhao as he sharply wheels his horse around. The horse snorts, sending visible puffs of breath into the freezing night air.

semantic_context.visual_goal: Deliver the climax command with maximum intensity.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Tight frame on Zhao's face, firelight reflecting in his eyes.
video_motion_hints: Zhao's facial expression contorts with aggressive, booming fury as he shouts. The flickering firelight casts dynamic, shifting shadows across his determined features.

semantic_context.visual_goal: Visually represent the thundering orchestral battle music kicking in.
semantic_context.action_focus: The violent impact of the mallet on the drumhead.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Extreme focus on the drumhead taking the impact.
video_motion_hints: The heavy mallet strikes the drumhead violently, compressing the leather top. A burst of powdery white snow erupts outward from the impact zone into the night air.

semantic_context.visual_goal: Show the unstoppable momentum and scale of the ambush.
semantic_context.action_focus: The vanguard sweeping down the mountain like an avalanche.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Camera positioned on the slope, tracking backward as the tidal wave of soldiers charges down toward the lens.
video_motion_hints: The camera tracks rapidly backward as the tidal wave of soldiers and horses charges furiously down the slope. Snow kicks up intensely beneath the thundering hooves.
